newsitem.title: USA: Polymer Group to begin tender.
newsitem.headline: Polymer Group to begin tender.

text.p: Polymer Group Inc said it plans to begin a cash tender offer and consent solicitation relating to all of its outstanding 12-1/4 percent Senior Notes due 2002 on June 5.

The total consideration to be paid for each validly tendered note and properly delivered consent will be based upon a fixed spread of 75 basis points over the yield to maturity on the 8 1/4 percent U.S. Treasury Note due July 15, 1998, which includes a consent payment of $10.00 per $1,000 principal amount of the notes.
The purchase price for the notes will be set at 1400 EDT (1800 GMT) on June 18, unless the offer is extended.
Chase Securities Inc. will be acting as the exclusive dealer manager for the tender offer and the consent solicitation.
